name: Figma AI
summary: Collaborative interface design tool with AI-powered features for design suggestions and automation.
description: Figma AI is the Figma design editor: a collaborative canvas for design, code, and AI suggestions inside a design file. It is not Figma Make, the separate prompt-to-app product at figma.com/make. Figma is the canvas where design, code, and AI come together. From first idea to shipped product — go from concept to production with your whole team, in one place. AI Content Generation: Creates text and images automatically. Text Assistance: Improves or rewrites design copy. Design Automation: Helps with layout and spacing. Image Suggestions: Recommends visuals for designs.
